title: Urban Heat Island Microclimate Simulation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D urban heat island microclimate simulation using Three.js (CDN). The scene models a 20x20 city grid where buildings, parks, roads, and water bodies interact thermally.

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrbitControls camera starting at position (30, 40, 30) looking at the origin.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.3) plus a DirectionalLight representing the sun at position (50, 80, 30) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- A ground plane (40x40 units) subdivided into a 20x20 grid of cells. Each cell is 2x2 units.
- Populate the grid procedurally with a seeded random (seed=2000): ~40% buildings (BoxGeometry, heights 2-12), ~25% roads (flat dark gray), ~20% parks (flat green with small cone trees), ~15% water (flat blue, slightly below ground level at y=-0.05).
- Color each cell by its current temperature using a gradient: blue (15°C) → green (25°C) → yellow (35°C) → red (45°C) → white (55°C).
- Enable renderer shadow mapping.

## Thermal Physics Model
- Each cell has properties: type ('building'|'road'|'park'|'water'), temperature (°C), albedo, thermalMass, heatCapacity.
- Base albedos: building=0.3, road=0.1, park=0.25, water=0.06.
- Thermal mass: building=3.0, road=1.5, park=2.0, water=4.5.
- Solar heating per tick: solarGain = solarIntensity * (1 - albedo) / thermalMass.
- Heat diffusion: each cell exchanges heat with its 4 neighbors (von Neumann) at rate diffusionCoeff=0.02 per tick.
- Cooling: each cell loses heat via radiation at rate coolingRate = 0.005 * (cellTemp - ambientTemp) per tick.
- Water cells have evaporative cooling: extra cooling of 0.01 * (cellTemp - ambientTemp).
- Parks have transpiration cooling: extra cooling of 0.006 * (cellTemp - ambientTemp).
- ambientTemp = 20°C. Initial cell temperatures: building=30, road=35, park=22, water=18.
- solarIntensity starts at 1.0.

## Simulation Controls
- The simulation runs in discrete ticks. It starts PAUSED.
- A 'Play/Pause' button (id='btn-play-pause') toggles simulation. When playing, run one tick every 200ms.
- A 'Step' button (id='btn-step') advances exactly one tick (only works when paused).
- A 'Reset' button (id='btn-reset') resets all temperatures to initial values and pauses.
- A slider (id='slider-solar', range 0.0 to 2.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) controls solarIntensity. Label shows current value (id='label-solar').
- A dropdown (id='select-tool') with options: 'inspect' (default), 'add-park', 'add-water', 'add-building'. When a tool other than inspect is selected, clicking a grid cell converts it to that type (resetting its temperature to the type's initial value, updating geometry).
- A 'Wind' toggle button (id='btn-wind') enables directional wind. When active, heat diffusion is biased: cells transfer 2x heat in the +X direction (simulating west-to-east wind).

## Raycasting & Inspection
- On click with 'inspect' tool, raycast to find the clicked cell. Display its info in a panel (id='info-panel'): cell coordinates, type, temperature (1 decimal), albedo, thermalMass.
- Highlight the selected cell with a wireframe outline.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD (id='hud') showing: current tick count, average temperature across all cells (1 decimal), min temperature, max temperature, count of cells above 40°C (hotspot count).
- All controls in a panel (id='controls-panel') at top-right.
- A color legend bar (id='legend') at the bottom showing the temperature-to-color mapping.

## State Management (CRITICAL)
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every tick and after every interaction:
  - tickCount: integer, starts at 0
  - isRunning: boolean
  - solarIntensity: number
  - windEnabled: boolean
  - gridData: flat array of 400 objects [{type, temperature, albedo, thermalMass, row, col}]
  - avgTemp: number (average temperature, 1 decimal precision)
  - minTemp: number
  - maxTemp: number
  - hotspotCount: integer (cells with temp > 40)
  - selectedCell: {row, col, type, temperature} or null
  - selectedTool: string
  - totalHeatEnergy: number (sum of all cell temperatures * thermalMass, for conservation tracking)
  - cellTypeCount: {building: N, road: N, park: N, water: N}
  - lastAction: string describing last user action (e.g. 'step', 'play', 'pause', 'reset', 'convert_cell', 'toggle_wind', 'set_solar')

Ensure all temperatures remain finite (no NaN/Infinity). The simulation must be deterministic given the same initial state and actions.
physics_constraints: Heat diffusion must obey discrete Laplacian with coefficient 0.02. Solar gain = solarIntensity*(1-albedo)/thermalMass per tick. Radiative cooling = 0.005*(T-Tambient). Water evaporative cooling adds 0.01*(T-Tambient). Park transpiration adds 0.006*(T-Tambient). Wind bias doubles diffusion in +X direction. All temperatures must remain finite. Total heat energy changes must be explainable by solar input minus cooling output (no spurious creation/destruction beyond numerical precision).
